notes: Shells that have opted into the self-contained pattern (shared/widgets/ for cross-surface components, <surface>/widgets/ for surface-local ones, each with a widgets.dart barrel, plus a design-system.md read out of the shell's own source). app_box has none yet, and an empty list is the honest value: gates/scaffold/scaffold.sh treats it as WARN + exit 0 — never a false fail, never a rubber stamp. app_box's shells today are app_shell, build, chat, design, intake, projects, settings and ship; none carries a widget home or a design-system.md, so listing any of them would assert a migration that has not happened. This file previously arrived verbatim from the kit exemplar this app was forked from (plan 8.1) and named showcase_notes_shell — a directory that exists in the kit, not here — so check S0 failed against app/ on every run: 'manifest names showcase_notes_shell but .../lib/ui/views/showcase_notes_shell does not exist'. When a shell does migrate, add it here in the same commit as its widgets.dart barrel.
